name: AI News
author: Ausdata

sections.description:
AI News is a powerful WordPress plugin that automatically generates AI-powered news articles using Google’s Gemini API and publishes them directly to your WordPress site. Perfect for content creators, news websites, and bloggers who want to maintain a steady stream of fresh, engaging content.

🚀 Key Features

AI Content Generation
* Powered by Google’s advanced Gemini 2.0 Flash (experimental) AI model
* Generates professional, news-quality articles automatically
* Supports both English and Chinese content generation
* Creates compelling headlines with structured content (introduction + detailed paragraphs)

Smart Automation
* Manual Mode: Generate articles on-demand with one-click generation
* Auto Mode: Set up automated scheduling (hourly, daily, weekly, or custom intervals)
* Smart Topic Rotation: Automatically rotates between selected topics for diverse content
* Batch Generation: Generate 1-10 articles per session

Content Customization
* 16+ Tech Topics: Choose from 4 categories including AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, Quantum Computing, Blockchain, IoT, VR/AR, Cybersecurity, and more
* Customizable Prompts: Use built-in templates or create your own AI prompts
* Prompt Management: Edit and save prompt templates directly from the admin interface
* Multi-language Support: Generate content in English or Chinese with localized prompts

Featured Image Generation
* AI-Generated Images: Automatically create relevant featured images for articles
* Multiple Services: Support for SiliconFlow and other AI image generation APIs
* Style Customization: Choose image styles and dimensions
* Smart Integration: Images are automatically set as featured images for generated posts

Professional Publishing
* Flexible Post Status: Publish immediately, save as drafts, or set for review
* Category Management: Automatically assign posts to selected categories
* Content Review: All generated content is saved with your chosen post status for quality control
* History Tracking: Complete log of all generated articles with edit/view links

🛠️ Easy Setup & Management

Simple Configuration
1. Get your free Gemini API key from Google AI Studio
2. Configure your preferred topics and generation schedule
3. Choose your content language and post settings
4. Start generating content immediately

User-Friendly Interface
* Clean, intuitive admin dashboard with tabbed navigation
* Real-time API connection testing
* Progress indicators and status updates
* Comprehensive settings management
* Built-in testing tools for all features

Smart Scheduling
* Choose from preset intervals (hourly, daily, weekly)
* Set custom time intervals (1 minute to 1 week)
* Pause/resume automation at any time
* Automatic conflict prevention between manual and auto modes

🎯 Perfect For

  • News Websites: Maintain fresh content with automated AI news generation
  • Tech Blogs: Generate articles about latest AI, ML, and technology developments
  • Content Marketers: Create consistent content streams for SEO and engagement
  • Multi-language Sites: Generate content in English and Chinese simultaneously
  • Small Teams: Reduce content creation workload with AI assistance
  • Educational Sites: Generate informative articles about emerging technologies

🔒 Security & Reliability

  • Secure API Integration: Safe handling of API keys and credentials
  • WordPress Standards: Built following WordPress coding standards and best practices
  • Error Handling: Comprehensive error handling and user feedback
  • Rate Limiting: Built-in API rate limiting to prevent service abuse
  • Data Protection: Secure storage of settings and generation history

📊 Performance & Monitoring

  • Generation History: Track all generated articles with timestamps
  • Statistics Dashboard: Monitor generation counts and schedule status
  • API Testing: Built-in tools to test connections and verify setup
  • Progress Tracking: Real-time progress indicators during generation
  • Error Logging: Detailed error reporting for troubleshooting

🌟 Why Choose AI News?

This plugin transforms your WordPress site into an AI-powered content generation hub. Whether you need a few articles per week or daily automated content, AI News provides the tools to create professional, engaging content that keeps your audience informed about the latest developments in technology and artificial intelligence.

Get started today and experience the future of automated content creation!

External Services

This plugin connects to several external services to provide AI-powered content and image generation. Below are the services used and the data transmitted:

Google Gemini API (Required)
* Purpose: AI content generation for news articles
* Data Sent: Article prompts and generation requests (no personal user data)
* When: When generating articles manually or automatically
* Service Provider: Google LLC
* Terms of Service: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

SiliconFlow API (Optional – Featured Images)
* Purpose: AI image generation for featured images
* Data Sent: Image generation prompts based on article titles (no personal data)
* When: When auto-featured image generation is enabled
* Service Provider: SiliconFlow
* Website: https://siliconflow.cn
* Terms of Service: https://siliconflow.cn/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://siliconflow.cn/privacy

OpenAI API (Optional – Featured Images)
* Purpose: DALL-E image generation and prompt optimization
* Data Sent: Image generation prompts and optimization requests (no personal data)
* When: When OpenAI image generation is selected
* Service Provider: OpenAI
* Terms of Service: https://openai.com/terms/
* Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/privacy/

DeepSeek API (Optional – Featured Images)
* Purpose: Prompt optimization for better image generation
* Data Sent: Article titles for prompt enhancement (no personal data)
* When: When using DeepSeek for prompt optimization
* Service Provider: DeepSeek
* Website: https://platform.deepseek.com
* Terms of Service: https://platform.deepseek.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://platform.deepseek.com/privacy

Unsplash API (Optional – Featured Images)
* Purpose: Stock photography for featured images
* Data Sent: Search queries based on article titles (no personal data)
* When: When Unsplash is selected as image source
* Service Provider: Unsplash Inc.
* Terms of Service: https://unsplash.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://unsplash.com/privacy

Pixabay API (Optional – Featured Images)
* Purpose: Free stock images for featured images
* Data Sent: Search queries based on article titles (no personal data)
* When: When Pixabay is selected as image source
* Service Provider: Pixabay GmbH
* Terms of Service: https://pixabay.com/service/terms/
* Privacy Policy: https://pixabay.com/service/privacy/

Important Notes:
– Only the Google Gemini API is required for basic functionality
– All other services are optional and used only for featured image generation
– No personal user data or sensitive information is transmitted to any service
– All API communications are secured with HTTPS
– You can disable featured image generation to avoid using optional services

sections.installation:
1. Upload the ai-news folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to ‘AI News’ in your WordPress admin menu
  4. Configure your Gemini API key and settings
  5. Start generating content!
sections.faq:
Do I need a Gemini API key?

Yes, you need a free Gemini API key from Google AI Studio. Visit https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey to get your key.

What languages are supported?

The plugin supports both English and Chinese content generation with localized prompts and topic selections.

Can I customize the AI prompts?

Yes! You can use built-in templates, create custom prompts, or edit existing ones directly from the admin interface.

How often can I generate articles?

You can generate articles manually at any time, or set up automated scheduling from hourly to weekly intervals.

Are the generated articles unique?

Yes, each article is uniquely generated based on your selected topics and current AI models, ensuring original content every time.

Can I review articles before publishing?

Absolutely! You can set articles to save as drafts, pending review, or publish immediately based on your preferences.

How do I access plugin information and statistics?

Click on “Plugin Info” in the plugin actions on your WordPress plugins page to view detailed information, statistics, and quick access links in a modern modal interface.

What topics are available?

The plugin includes 16+ tech topics across 4 categories: Tech Frontiers, Applications, Emerging Tech, and Industry Applications.

Is featured image generation included?

Yes! The plugin can automatically generate relevant featured images using AI image generation services.
